note: Settings the scorer uses when no flag is given. They are first settings chosen for mstack, not measured values. There is no default floor: what hit rate is good enough depends on the corpus and the questions, so the user sets it or saves a baseline.

at_k.unit: the k at which the hit rate is judged (the answer passage has to be among the first k ids)
at_k.source: mstack default, first setting; use the number of passages your application really puts in the prompt

k_list.unit: values of k that are reported

min_questions.unit: gold questions needed before a verdict is given
min_questions.source: mstack default, first setting; with fewer, one question moves the hit rate by more than ten points

max_drop.unit: hit rate or mean reciprocal rank (0 to 1) the run may lose against the baseline before it fails
